svg.title: Yono 字形研究 04 · 字形母版
svg.desc: Yono glyph study 04: hard-pen semi-running Chinese with whiteboard-inspired Latin. All specimen glyphs are editable filled vector outlines. Annotation text uses system fonts. This is a design study, not a complete font.
svg.text: 每个字形均为独立矢量轮廓；浅灰线标示字面、基线及 advance。
